summary: The quest diagram, an Available tab that tells you what to do next, a quest window you can resize, and a quieter way to draw quest areas.

highlights.title: The quest diagram
highlights.text: Open a quest's whole chain as a tree from its page: what comes before above, what follows below, each quest with its level, where it stands for you and its giver. Click a quest to read its page beside the tree.
highlights.alt: The quest diagram of Cutting Teeth: the quest at the top, the three quests it unlocks below, and its page beside the tree.

highlights.title: What to do next, on the Available tab
highlights.text: Quests come in sections: pick up now, opens from your log, opens after a pick-up, needs a level, needs something else. Each says what opens it, how many steps away it is, its experience and how far its giver is.
highlights.alt: The Available tab in the Barrens: quests to pick up now with their givers, distances and experience, and the page of The Swarm Grows.

highlights.title: What a quest unlocks
highlights.text: A quest that opens others shows a small key with how many. Its tooltip and its page name them, with the quests that must be done first.
highlights.alt: The tracker with the quest Cutting Teeth, and its tooltip naming the three quests it unlocks.

highlights.title: Resize the quest window
highlights.text: Drag the grip at the window's corner: down makes the map larger and the window as tall beside it, right makes its page wider. Hold Shift to scale the text too; a right click puts the usual size back.
highlights.alt: The map and quest window made larger with the grip at the window's corner: a taller map and a wider quest page.

highlights.title: Quest areas as shadows
highlights.text: A new look for quest areas: a soft tinted shadow where each quest's spawns are, no rings and no lines. The quietest on the map, and the lightest to draw.
highlights.alt: The Barrens map with quest areas drawn as soft shadows, beside the quest log.
